overall: The AG found the committee properly reviewed OML complaints against its own members in Purpose 1 executive session and owed the named complainant no individual notice; no violation, complaints resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee met in executive session on Dec. 22, 2021 and Jan. 5, 2022 for an improper purpose, namely to discuss prior OML complaints.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Committee was permitted to conduct its review in executive session during both the December 22, 2021, and January 5, 2022, meetings, and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the notice named her as the complainant but the committee did not individually notify her that she would be discussed at the executive sessions.
allegations.key_passage: and the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by not giving her individual notice of the meetings.
